data.title: 帕瓦 · 晨光杂乱被窝的撒娇噘嘴
data.description: 早晨刺眼的阳光直射在杂乱无章的被窝上。帕瓦被子裹成一团，单边肩头露在外面，一件松垮的背心歪斜挂在身上，纤细的锁骨与光洁肩膀暴露无遗。红色的犄角陷在羽绒枕头里，她把脸埋在枕头里噘着嘴发出不满的哼哼声，一双金红十字眼从凌乱的金发缝隙里瞪着你，抱怨着太早起床必须要你给做大盘烤肉才肯动弹。
data.action: tousled in messy bedsheets, tank top slipping off bare shoulder, red horns sticking out of pillow, pouting heavily with messy blonde hair covering eyes, cute grumpiness
data.location: cluttered apartment bedroom bathed in bright morning sunshine
data.lighting: harsh cheerful morning sunbeams highlighting floating dust and tousled blonde hair
data.mood: hilarious spoiled gremlin morning, strangely sweet domestic bond
data.promptProse: Burrowed amidst messy tangled blankets in morning sunshine, Power pouts furiously with her tank top slipping off one shoulder. Her red horns poke through tangled blonde hair as she glares with adorable morning grumpiness.
data.animaCaption: Power pouting from a messy bed in morning sunlight with her tank top slipping off her shoulder.
